title: Gossipsub hierarchy-level topics prevent subscription explosion for large hierarchies
description: Transit subscribes to usenet.hier.<first_component> topics (e.g., usenet.hier.comp for all comp.* groups). An alternative would be per-group topics. Per-group topics would require each peer to maintain O(groups_served) subscriptions — for a server carrying even 100 groups in comp.* that is 100 libp2p topic subscriptions vs 1. Gossipsub has practical limits on the number of topics a node can actively maintain mesh memberships for. A contributor might suggest 'more targeted per-group subscriptions to reduce noise' — this is wrong: the noise is handled by the in-topic filter (gossip/filter.rs) which already dispatches by group_name from the JSON payload.
